How to choose and submit
  1. Choose functionality. Click a capability to keep, pin or exclude it. Dependencies are applied automatically.
  2. Set the code target. Choose the size of the new implementation relative to the entire original source. The selected functionality stays fixed.
  3. Submit your selection. Save the chosen scope and target and receive a receipt. Behavior checks and the original baseline still need preparation before rewriting.
